title: The World Now Has More Obese Adults Than Underweight Ones
hook: That Flipped In Just A Few Decades
source: WHO Global Health Observatory and NCD Risk Factor Collaboration (NCD-RisC) age-standardized adult prevalence estimates, 1975-2022. Approximate, order-of-magnitude figures; global obesity prevalence overtook underweight prevalence in the mid-2000s and the gap has kept widening.
